changes: Selected original native-coordinate meshes from four Open3D source regional GLBs; exact duplicates removed and overlapping source variants selected by documented region precedence. Stable original IDs, geometry/Draco bytes, image bytes, UVs, normals and physical materials retained; no generated or mirrored anatomy.
limitations: Incomplete predominantly right-sided adult male overview from four Open3D regional source selections. It is not a complete bilateral human model.
No missing left limb, skin, facial muscle, internal organ, vessel, nerve or other anatomy has been inferred, mirrored, synthesized or registered from another dataset.
Original native global coordinates are retained: metres, Y up, anterior +Z, anatomical left +X. No translation, rotation, rescaling, registration, cropping or mesh averaging was applied.
Only one complete skeletal source is displayed. Regional skeletal alternatives may have small geometric differences; these are logged as variants, not mislabeled as exact duplicates.

At shared shoulder/trunk/hip structures, one authored original variant is selected. Small source-version shape differences remain possible at interfaces; this is not a watertight fused mesh or an independently validated complete anatomical atlas.
Some nerve/vessel/joint representations are truncated at regional boundaries. Their presence does not establish continuity through an unmodeled region.
Educational colored overlays/attachment surfaces are omitted from this physical overview and remain available in the separate regional datasets.

The torso source labels some larger iliopsoas representations .r despite bilateral/different extent. This overview uses the original lower-limb right iliacus, psoas major and psoas minor variants without splitting geometry.

Model source table is CC BY-SA 4.0; separately distributed UBC-derived muscle textures are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Their exact embedded-image lineage is not enumerated per file by the source, so preserve both notices and restrict this textured package to noncommercial educational reuse unless clarified.
